title.narrative: Support to the International Conference on the Implementation of UN Resolution A/80/L.48 and Reparatory Justice

description.narrative: To support the efforts of the Government of Ghana in mobilizing the international community around the implementation of United Nations Resolution A/80/L.48, which recognizes the trafficking of enslaved Africans and racialized chattel enslavement as among the gravest crimes against humanity, and to strengthen dialogue between Africa and its diasporas on issues of historical memory, reparatory justice and historical recognition.
